sources.cite: Homer. Iliad 18.478–608. Edited by A. T. Murray. 2 vols. Loeb Classical Library. London: Heinemann; New York: Putnam, 1924–25.

bands.title: Cosmos
bands.summary: Earth, sky, sea, the heavenly bodies, and the constellations fill the shield's center.

bands.title: City at Peace
bands.summary: A wedding procession moves through the streets while a lawsuit is argued in the agora.

bands.title: City at War
bands.summary: A besieged city sends an ambush to the river, where the two forces meet in battle.

bands.title: Fallow Field
bands.summary: Ploughmen turn their teams across a broad field that has been worked three times.

bands.title: King's Estate
bands.summary: Reapers gather grain before the king while attendants prepare the harvest meal.

bands.title: Vineyard
bands.summary: Young people carry ripe grapes from a vineyard as a boy plays and sings.

bands.title: Cattle and Lions
bands.summary: Two lions seize a bull from the herd while herdsmen and dogs try to drive them off.

bands.title: Sheep Pasture
bands.summary: A valley holds a large sheep pasture with folds, shelters, and pens.

bands.title: Dancing Floor
bands.summary: Young men and women dance on a floor like the one Daedalus made for Ariadne at Knossos.

bands.title: Ocean
bands.summary: The river Ocean runs around the shield's outermost rim.
